## Activity

This report summarises activity at East City Eye Clinic during April 2020. The site recorded 54 captures during the reporting month. This provides the activity measure for the period and establishes the volume against which image quality and grading outcomes are considered. The recorded activity should be retained for routine service monitoring and comparison with subsequent reporting periods.

## Image quality

Image quality review identified 1 ungradable capture. The ungradable rate was 1.9 of captures. This result should be noted in the routine review of image quality and follow-up arrangements. The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk so that equipment-related concerns can be tracked and addressed through the appropriate operational process.

## Grading

Grading identified 6 referable results from the recorded captures. The median wait from photograph to grade was 1. This provides the reported measure of the time between image capture and completion of grading. Activity, image quality, and grading results should continue to be reviewed together to support oversight of the service at East City Eye Clinic.
